## GitHub issues

Use issue templates for **bugs** and **feature requests**:

- [Bug report](https://github.com/CPF-Chula-CEDT-2026/spark/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)
- [Feature request](https://github.com/CPF-Chula-CEDT-2026/spark/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml)

Include reproduction steps, branch/commit, and redacted logs. Do **not** attach real plant manuals or credentials.

## Security issues

Report vulnerabilities privately via [`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md) — never in public issues.

## Contributing code

See [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for dev setup, branch flow (`develop` ← feature PRs), and CI expectations.

## Response time

This is a best-effort academic / partner engineering project. Critical production or safety issues on deployed factories should also be escalated through your organization's on-call channel in parallel with a GitHub issue or security advisory.
